questions.question: Which SAP tools support you in your application lifecycle management tasks? (3)
questions.why: SAP Solution Manager is an important tool in the ALM context for on-premise centric customers. SAP Cloud ALM is SAP's ALM tool for cloud-centric customers and SAP Focused Run is the operations platform for service providers and high end hybrid customers. SAP LPT1 is a fictitious name.

questions.question: Which of the following statements about load balancing in SAP systems are correct? (3)

options.text: The Internet Communication Manager (ICM) distributes HTTP requests to all available application servers on your SAP system.
The ABAP Message Server can distribute requests to all available application servers during logon with the SAP GUI.
The ABAP dispatcher distributes user requests to the work processes of the present application server.
The SAP Web Dispatcher can distribute HTTP requests to different application servers of an SAP system in succession.

questions.why: The Internet Communication Manager (ICM) of an application server instance can only forward HTTP requests to the processes in its own application servers. If load balancing is desired for HTTP requests, the SAP Web Dispatcher can be installed on a computer in the demilitarized zone (DMZ) and be connected to one or more SAP system(s).

questions.question: Which tools does the SAP Solution Manager system provide for the operation of business processes? (2)
questions.why: Business Process Monitoring and Interface Monitoring are tools provided by the SAP Solution Manager system. The Quick Sizer tool is available outside the SAP system.

questions.question: Which tools can be used to implement an SAP Support Package Stack into an existing AS ABAP-based SAP system? (2)
questions.why: SAP Support Packages can be implemented either with the help of SAP Support Package Manager or with SAP Software Update Manager. SAP Software Provisioning Manager can be used to install SAP systems, and SAP Maintenance Planner is used to calculate Support Package Stacks on SAP Support Portal and to prepare them for download.

questions.question: Which of the following are SAP systems? (3)
questions.why: The SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA Server and SAP BW are SAP systems. SAP ERP is not an SAP system, it is an application. SAP Business Suite is not an SAP system, it is the bundle of the applications SAP ERP, SAP CRM, SAP SCM, SAP SRM and SAP PLM.

questions.question: SAP recommends a three-system landscape as the minimal landscape when performing own development. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: A three-system landscape is the recommended minimal landscape when performing own development.

questions.question: Which of the following is always cross-client?
questions.why: Repository objects are always cross-client. Application data is client-specific. Customizing is partly client-specific and partly cross-client. User master records are client-specific.

questions.question: Which of the following are standard (logical) client roles? (3)
questions.why: Development and Customizing, Quality Assurance and Production are standard (logical) client roles. Monitoring and Importing are not client roles.

questions.question: If you set the client change options (transaction SCC4) for client 100 to Changes to repository and cross-client customizing allowed and the system change options (transaction SE06) global settings to Not Modifiable, you can then change repository objects from within client 100. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: It is not possible to change repository objects if the system change options, global settings are set to Not Modifiable. It does not matter how the client change options are set in this case.

questions.question: Which of the following client change options allow you to change client-specific customizing within the specific client? (3)

options.text: Changes w/o automatic recording, no transports allowed

questions.why: Changes without automatic recording, Automatic recording of changes and Changes w/o automatic recording, no transports allowed allow you to change client-specific customizing within the specific client. No changes allowed does not allow you to change client-specific customizing within the specific client.

questions.question: A transport domain always consists of only one transport directory. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: A transport domain can consist of several transport directories, whereby each transport directory is part of exactly one transport group.

questions.question: When setting up the Transport Management System (TMS), some steps must be performed in a certain sequence. What is the correct sequence? (Note: this ordering question has been rendered as a single-answer sequence question.)

options.text: Create a transport directory → Create a transport domain → Define the SAP systems of the transport domain → Configure the transport routes → Configure the Quality Assurance (QA) procedure
Create a transport domain → Create a transport directory → Define the SAP systems of the transport domain → Configure the transport routes → Configure the Quality Assurance (QA) procedure
Create a transport directory → Create a transport domain → Define the SAP systems of the transport domain → Configure the Quality Assurance (QA) procedure → Configure the transport routes
Create a transport directory → Define the SAP systems of the transport domain → Create a transport domain → Configure the transport routes → Configure the Quality Assurance (QA) procedure

questions.why: First, you need to create a transport directory, and then, create a transport domain. You then need to define the SAP systems of the transport domain, configure the transport routes, and finally configure the Quality Assurance (QA) procedure (optional).

questions.question: Which actions are performed automatically when creating a new transport domain in Transport Management System (transaction STMS)? (3)

options.text: The SAP system is assigned to the transport domain
The standard transport layer is created
The Quality Assurance (QA) procedure is set up
User TMSADM is created in client 000

questions.why: When creating a new transport domain in Transport Management System (transaction STMS), the SAP system is assigned to the transport domain, a transport group is created, and user TMSADM is created in client 000. The standard transport layer is defined when defining the transport routes. The Quality Assurance (QA) procedure must be set up manually (if needed).

questions.question: You want transport requests that are exported from the development system to be added to the import queues of multiple quality assurance systems simultaneously. Which technique should be used for this?
questions.why: You should use transport target groups for this. Client-specific transport routes allow you to define the transport routes per client. The Quality Assurance (QA) procedure can prevent untested transport requests to be imported into the production system. External systems are used to transport via multiple transport directories.

questions.question: From a technical point of view, a customizing setting is table contents in one or more tables. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: From a technical point of view, a customizing setting is table contents in one or more tables.

questions.question: Which of the following statements are true concerning transport requests for customizing? (3)

options.text: A transport request can consist of one or more tasks.
All tasks of a transport requests must be assigned to the same owner.
You can use the Transport Organizer (transaction SE09) to create transport requests.
The owner of the transport request must be the owner of at least one task of the transport request.
A transport request always has exactly one owner.

questions.why: A transport request for customizing can consist of one or more tasks, it can be created with the Transport Organizer, and it always has exactly one owner. The different tasks of a transport request can be assigned to different owners. The owner of the transport request does not need to own a task in the transport request.

questions.question: Where is a CTS project mainly used in the context of transport requests?

options.text: To define the target system of transport requests
To assign tasks to transport requests

questions.why: A CTS project is used to group transport requests, for example, to import them together or to perform the Quality Assurance (QA) procedure for one whole project. The target system is defined within the transport request itself. Tasks are defined within the transport request. Transport requests are released by using the Transport Organizer.

questions.question: When performing customizing that should be transported, steps must be performed in a certain sequence. What is the correct sequence? (Note: this ordering question has been rendered as a single-answer sequence question.)

options.text: Start the customizing transaction → Assign customizing settings to a task of a transport request → Release all tasks of the transport request → Release the transport request → Import the transport request into subsequent SAP systems

Start the customizing transaction → Assign customizing settings to a task of a transport request → Release the transport request → Release all tasks of the transport request → Import the transport request into subsequent SAP systems

Assign customizing settings to a task of a transport request → Start the customizing transaction → Release all tasks of the transport request → Release the transport request → Import the transport request into subsequent SAP systems

Start the customizing transaction → Assign customizing settings to a task of a transport request → Release all tasks of the transport request → Import the transport request into subsequent SAP systems → Release the transport request

questions.why: First you start the customizing transaction and then you assign the customizing settings to a task of a transport request (that should have been created before). You then release all tasks of this transport request, followed by releasing the transport request, and then you can import the transport request into the subsequent SAP systems.

questions.question: To transport customizing settings, a customizing request is always used. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: Depending on the type of customizing, a customizing request is used for client-specific customizing and a workbench request is used for cross-client customizing.

questions.question: Which of the following statements are correct for packages in the context of development and transport? (3)

options.text: Repository objects can be assigned to a package
A package can be assigned to a software component
A package can be assigned to a transport layer
Customizing objects can be assigned to a package
A repository object can be assigned to several packages

questions.why: Repository objects can be assigned to a package, a package can be assigned to a software component, and a package can be assigned to a transport layer. Customizing objects can not be assigned to a package. A repository object can not be assigned to several packages.

questions.question: Which object combinations can be transported within one single workbench request? (3)

options.text: Any custom developed objects assigned to different packages if the packages are assigned to the same transport layer
Custom developed objects and SAP standard objects and if the packages of all objects are assigned to transport layers that point to the same target system (and client)
Any custom developed objects if they are assigned to custom developed packages
Any SAP standard objects (independent of the software components their packages are assigned to)

questions.why: You can transport with one single workbench request the following: Any custom developed objects assigned to different packages if the packages are assigned to the same transport layer, custom developed objects and SAP standard objects if the packages of all objects are assigned to transport layers that point to the same target system, and any SAP standard objects independent of the software components their packages are assigned to. You cannot transport any custom developed objects with one single workbench request if they are assigned to custom developed packages, or if their packages are assigned to different transport layers pointing to different transport target systems (and clients).

questions.question: You are changing a customer developed program. The program is assigned to a transport request. When is the object lock released?

options.text: When the transport request in released
When the task which the program is assigned to is released

questions.why: The object lock is released at the time when the transport request is released. Releasing the task which the program is assigned to, activating the program, or generating the program does not release the object lock.

questions.question: Which of the following actions can trigger the creation of a version for a repository object in the version database? (3)

options.text: Releasing the corresponding transport request (' ' version)
Importing the corresponding transport request ('I' version), if the corresponding tp parameter is set correctly
Saving and activating the object manually ('A' version)

questions.why: A version for a repository object in the version database can be created by releasing the corresponding transport request, by importing the corresponding transport request, and by creating a (temporary) version manually. No version is created just by saving and activating the object manually.

questions.question: What tasks can you perform by using the Transport Organizer Tools (transaction SE03)? (3)

options.text: Search for objects in transport requests

questions.why: You use the Transport Organizer Tools for searching for objects in transport requests, unlocking objects, and setting general transport request attributes. You use the Transport Organizer (transaction SE09) for creating transport requests and releasing transport requests.

questions.question: Creating and changing a customer repository object in the (original) development system is recorded in a task of type Development/Correction, changing an SAP standard object in the development system is recorded in a task of type Repair. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: Creating and changing a customer repository object in the (original) development system is recorded in a task of type Development/Correction, changing an SAP standard object in the development system is recorded in a task of type Repair.

questions.question: Which status can a task have within a transportable transport request depending on its contents? (3)
questions.why: A task within a transportable transport request can have the status Unclassified (no objects contained), Development/Correction (typically: own development contained), and Repair (typically: SAP standard object contained). There is no status Local for a task, but a transport request can be local or transportable.

questions.question: When modifying an SAP standard object, modification adjustment is always necessary when applying the latest SAP Support Packages. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: A modification adjustment is necessary only if the SAP Support Packages applied also contain the modified object.

questions.question: When modifying an SAP standard object, this is always done under the control of the Modification Assistant. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: It depends on the object type, if the Modification Assistant is available.

questions.question: You are running a development project in a three-system landscape using the Quality Assurance (QA) approval procedure. After fixing some errors that have been detected during the test, quality assurance testing in the quality assurance system for the project finally is positive. Which transport requests should you import into the production system?

options.text: The entire project which includes all approved transport requests assigned to the project
Exactly those transport requests that contain only error-free objects
If the same objects are contained in multiple transport requests, only import the newest transport requests
All transport requests from the import queue of the production system

questions.why: You should import the entire project which causes all approved transport requests assigned to the project to be imported. You should not leave away any approved transport requests of the project or import additional transport requests.

questions.question: You are using a standard three-system landscape: When releasing a transportable transport request from the development system, it is being exported from the development system and immediately imported into the quality assurance system. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: Releasing a transportable transport request does not cause an immediate import into the subsequent system(s).

questions.question: You are using client independent transport routes. Which information can be seen in the import queue (transaction STMS) for transport requests that have not imported been yet? (4)
questions.why: The owner, source client, component check result, and type of the transport request can be seen in the import queue. The target client is not set and therefore not visible in case of client independent transport routes.

questions.question: You are using a standard three-system landscape. You did not add or delete any transport requests manually from the import queues. What is the sequence of the transport requests in the import queue of the production system?

options.text: The sequence in which the transport requests were imported into the quality assurance system
The sequence in which the transport requests were released from the development system
The sequence of the time stamp of the creation of the transport requests
The sequence of the 5-digit number of the transport requests

questions.why: The sequence of the transport requests in the import queue of the production system is the sequence the transport requests were imported into the quality assurance system.

questions.question: Which of the following are transport strategies of the Transport Management System (TMS)? (3)
questions.why: Queue-Driven Transports, Mass transports as well as Queue-Driven Transports, Single transports, and Workflow-driven transports are transport strategies. Queue-Driven Transports, Project based transports is not a transport strategy.

questions.question: What is different when using a transport of copies instead of a workbench request? (3)

options.text: You can choose any SAP system of the transport domain as the target system
You do not need any consolidation route to the target system
You can transport together any transportable objects
Copies of the objects are being transported, not the originals
The objects are being copied from the source system

questions.why: The differences are that you can choose any SAP system of the transport domain as the target system, you do not need any consolidation route to the target system, and you can transport together any transportable objects. There is no difference in copies of the objects are being transported, or objects are being copied from the source system. This is the same as with workbench requests.

questions.question: You are using a standard three-system landscape. By using the Transport Management System (transaction STMS), it is possible to perform an automatic, periodic import of all transport requests of the import queue into the quality assurance system, for example once every 24 hours. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: It is possible to perform an automatic, periodic import of all transport requests of the import queue into the quality assurance system.

questions.question: You are using a standard three-system landscape with standard transport routes: For increased transport security, it makes sense to define the Quality Assurance (QA) approval procedure not only in the quality assurance system but also in the production system. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: It makes no sense to define the QA approval procedure in the production system because there are no subsequent systems to be secured.

questions.question: You are defining the Quality Assurance (QA) approval procedure. Which standard approval steps are selectable? (3)

options.text: To be approved by request owner
To be approved by system administration
To be approved by task owner

questions.why: The selectable standard approval steps are: To be approved by department, to be approved by request owner, and to be approved by system administration. To be approved by developer and to be approved by task owner are no standard approval steps.

questions.question: You are using a standard three-system landscape with Quality Assurance (QA) approval procedure. There are five transport requests in the import queue of the production system. The second transport request has not been approved yet, the others are approved. What happens in general, when you start an import all (import of all transport requests) into the production system?

options.text: The behavior depends on the setting of tp parameter HANDLING_OF_INACTIVE_TRANSPORTS
All approved transport requests are imported
Only the first transport request is being imported
The behavior depends on the setting of the transport strategy

questions.why: The behavior depends on the setting of tp parameter HANDLING_OF_INACTIVE_TRANSPORTS (BREAK, STOP, SKIP). In general, not all approved transport requests are imported and not only the first transport request is being imported. The behavior does not depend on the setting of the transport strategy.

questions.question: During the import of transport requests, several steps are performed. What is the correct sequence? (Note: this ordering question has been rendered as a single-answer sequence question.)

options.text: Import of dictionary objects (for example, table structures) → Handling of dictionary objects (for example, activation) → Import of other objects (for example, programs) → Handling of other objects (for example, generation)

Import of dictionary objects (for example, table structures) → Import of other objects (for example, programs) → Handling of dictionary objects (for example, activation) → Handling of other objects (for example, generation)

Handling of dictionary objects (for example, activation) → Import of dictionary objects (for example, table structures) → Import of other objects (for example, programs) → Handling of other objects (for example, generation)

Import of dictionary objects (for example, table structures) → Handling of dictionary objects (for example, activation) → Handling of other objects (for example, generation) → Import of other objects (for example, programs)

questions.why: The import of the dictionary objects takes place first, then the dictionary objects are handled, followed by the other objects are being imported, and finally the other objects are being handled.

questions.question: Which tool is performing the dictionary import during the import of transport requests?
questions.why: R3trans performs the dictionary import. RDDIMPDP is the import dispatcher, RDDMASGL is responsible for the activation of dictionary objects, and R3load is not used in the context of importing transport requests.

questions.question: Which of the following are monitoring tools when importing transport requests? (3)
questions.why: Check for critical objects, import monitor, and import history are monitoring tools. A performance monitor does not exist for importing transport requests.

questions.question: What is the SAP standard procedure to clean up the transport directory?

options.text: Using command line options of tp
Scheduling one of the standard batch jobs
Switching on the automatic cleanup in TMS
Setting the corresponding attribute for transport requests

questions.why: Command line options of tp are used (tp check all and tp clearold all). For this there is no standard batch job, no automatic cleanup in TMS, and no corresponding attribute for transport requests.

questions.question: Which landscape is best practice for solutions with production support and development projects of a medium scope?
questions.why: The four-system landscape is best practice for solutions with production support and development projects of a medium scope. Three-system landscapes are best suited for solutions with production support and development projects of a minimum scope, five-system landscapes are used in large implementation projects parallel to production support.

questions.question: You want to perform a remote client copy of client 100 of your development system to client 200 of your quality assurance system, using transaction SCC9. You want to use 16 parallel processes. Which of the following statements are correct regarding the client copy? (3)

options.text: An RFC server group (RZ12) must exist in the quality assurance system
An RFC server group (RZ12) must exist in the development system
You start the remote client copy (SCC9) in the quality assurance system
You start the remote client copy (SCC9) in the development system
An RFC destination (SM59) must exist in the quality assurance system, pointing to client 100 of the development system
An RFC destination (SM59) must exist in the development system, pointing to client 200 of the quality assurance system

questions.why: An RFC server group (RZ12) must exist in the quality assurance system, you start the remote client copy (SCC9) in the quality assurance system, and an RFC destination (SM59) must exist in the quality assurance system, pointing to client 100 of the development system. You do not need an RFC server group (RZ12) in the development system, you do not start the remote client copy (SCC9) in the development system, and no RFC destination (SM59) needs to exist in the development system, pointing to client 200 of the quality assurance system.

questions.question: If you want to delete client 001 via transaction SCC5 in your SAP ECC development system using 16 parallel processes, you need an RFC server group (RZ12) in the development system for this. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: You need an RFC server group (RZ12) in the development system if you want to run parallel processes in transaction SCC5.

questions.question: You want to perform a client compare with the Customizing Cross-System Viewer (transaction SCU0) from client 100 of the development system to client 100 of the quality assurance system. With the help of this tool, you can also compare the repository doing this. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: A client compare with transaction SCU0 is designed only for comparing customizing settings, no repository comparison. To compare the repository, you can use Repository Comparison (transaction SREPO).

questions.question: You are logged on in client 100 of the development system DEV and want to perform a client compare with the Customizing Cross-System Viewer (SCU0) with client 100 of the quality assurance system QAS. You do not want to adjust, only compare. Which of the following client change options (SCC4) would make the client compare impossible?

options.text: In QAS, client 100: Protection level 2: No overwriting, no external availability
In QAS, client 100: Protection level 1: No overwriting
In DEV, client 100: Protection level 2: No overwriting, no external availability
In DEV, client 100: Protection level 1: No overwriting

questions.why: In QAS, client 100: Protection level 2: No overwriting, no external availability would make the client comparison impossible. The other settings would not influence this client compare.

questions.question: When applying an SAP Note with the SAP Note Assistant, neither a developer key nor an object key is necessary for applying the SAP Note itself but both keys can be necessary in systems of SAP Business Suite for manual activities related to the SAP Note. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: When applying an SAP Note with the SAP Note Assistant, neither a developer key nor an object key is necessary for applying the SAP Note itself but both keys can be necessary for manual activities related to the SAP Note, for example, for creating a package or changing a table structure in systems of SAP Business Suite.

questions.question: Which tools can be used to apply SAP Support Packages? (2)
questions.why: You can apply SAP Support Packages using SPAM or SUM. TMS is used to import transport requests. SNOTE is used to apply SAP Notes.

questions.question: It is possible to perform an SAP system upgrade from SAP ECC 6.05 to SAP S/4HANA Server 2022. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: You can't perform an upgrade from SAP ECC 6.05 to SAP S/4HANA Server 2022, but you can perform an SAP S/4HANA Conversion from SAP ECC 6.05 to SAP S/4HANA Server 2022.

questions.question: Modification adjustments should be performed by SAP system administrators. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: Modification adjustments should be performed by developers and not by SAP system administrators.

questions.question: You are running a three-system landscape. You want to activate a business function with the Switch Framework (transaction SFW5). What is the correct sequence of the activation procedure? (Note: this ordering question has been rendered as a single-answer sequence question.)

options.text: In a temporary sandbox system, activate the business functions for test purposes with SFW5. → In the development system, activate the correct business functions with SFW5. → In the development system, create a transport request containing the activated business functions with SFW5 and release the transport request. → In the quality assurance system, import the transport request with STMS and perform quality assurance testing. → In the production system, import the transport request with STMS.

In the development system, activate the correct business functions with SFW5. → In a temporary sandbox system, activate the business functions for test purposes with SFW5. → In the development system, create a transport request containing the activated business functions with SFW5 and release the transport request. → In the quality assurance system, import the transport request with STMS and perform quality assurance testing. → In the production system, import the transport request with STMS.

In a temporary sandbox system, activate the business functions for test purposes with SFW5. → In the development system, create a transport request containing the activated business functions with SFW5 and release the transport request. → In the development system, activate the correct business functions with SFW5. → In the quality assurance system, import the transport request with STMS and perform quality assurance testing. → In the production system, import the transport request with STMS.

In a temporary sandbox system, activate the business functions for test purposes with SFW5. → In the development system, activate the correct business functions with SFW5. → In the development system, create a transport request containing the activated business functions with SFW5 and release the transport request. → In the production system, import the transport request with STMS. → In the quality assurance system, import the transport request with STMS and perform quality assurance testing.

questions.why: First you activate the business functions for test purposes with transaction SFW5 in a temporary sandbox system, then you activate the correct business functions with transaction SFW5 in the development system. You then create a transport request containing the activated business functions with transaction SFW5 in the development system and release the transport request. Next, you import the transport request with transaction STMS in the quality assurance system and perform quality assurance testing, and finally, you import the transport request with transaction STMS in the production system.

questions.question: Which of these SAP systems is not an AS ABAP based SAP system?
questions.why: SAP EP is not an AS ABAP based SAP system. Read more on this in the lesson Describing SAP Systems of the course ADM110.

questions.question: Which software components (among others) can be found in every AS ABAP-based SAP system? (2)
questions.why: The software components SAP_BASIS and SAP_ABA can be found in every AS ABAP-based SAP system. The software component SAP_APPL can be found in SAP ECC systems. The software component S4CORE can be found in SAP S/4HANA Server systems. Read more on this in the lesson Describing SAP Systems of the course ADM110.

questions.question: Which process distributes the incoming requests to the available server processes in an AS Java-based SAP system?
questions.why: The process which distributes the incoming requests to the available server processes in an AS Java-based SAP system is Internet Communication Server (ICM). Read more on this in the lesson Describing the Processes of AS ABAP and AS Java-based SAP system in course ADM110.

questions.question: Which process is always part of the central services instance of an AS Java-based SAP system with release 750? (3)
questions.why: A Message Server, an Enqueue Service, and an RFC Gateway is always part of the central services instance of an AS Java-based SAP system with release 750.

questions.question: Which release of AS ABAP does SAP Solution Manager ABAP 7.2 use?
questions.why: SAP Solution Manager ABAP 7.2 uses AS ABAP 7.40, other releases of AS ABAP are not possible to use for SAP Solution Manager ABAP 7.2. Read more on this in the lesson List the SAP Systems that will be installed and updated in this course of the course ADM110.

questions.question: You choose 42 as the instance number for the application server. What will the ABAP dispatcher port be?
questions.why: The port for an ABAP dispatcher will be 3242. Read more on this in the lesson Installing an SAP S/4HANA Server system of the course ADM110.

questions.question: When you install an SAP S/4HANA Server system, how do you install the SAP HANA DB?

options.text: Use a database tool to install the SAP HANA DB before starting SAPinst
Use SAPinst to install the SAP HANA DB before any other SAP system instances
Use SAPinst to install the SAP HANA DB and other SAP system instances in a single run
Use Software Provisioning Manager to install the SAP HANA DB before any other SAP system instances

questions.why: The SAP HANA DB needs to be installed using some database tool before starting SAPinst. Read more on this in the lesson Installing an SAP S/4HANA Server system of the course ADM110.

questions.question: Identify the name of a database schema that will be created during the installation of an SAP S/4HANA Server 2023 system when using SAPinst?
questions.why: The database schema SAPHANADB will be created during the installation of SAP S/4HANA Server 2023 system using SAPinst. Read more on this in the lesson Installing an SAP S/4HANA Server system of the course ADM110.

questions.question: When you use the parameter mode Typical for an installation procedure, this setting will determine some parameter values that can't be changed during the following installation process. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: The parameter mode Typical allows you to revise every installation parameter before the non-dialog part of the installation will start. Read more on this in the lesson Installing an SAP S/4HANA Server system of the course ADM110.

questions.question: You are installing an SAP S/4HANA Server 2023 system. During this installation you can use any kernel released for this SAP system release. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: When installing an SAP S/4HANA Server 2023 system you should always use the kernel, calculated by Maintenance Planner. Read more on this in the lesson Installing an SAP S/4HANA Server System of the course ADM110.

questions.question: SAP recommends that you use unique SAP system IDs (SID) throughout your SAP system landscape. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: SAP recommends that you use unique SAP system IDs (SID) throughout your SAP system landscape. Read more about this in the lesson Installing an SAP Solution Manager ABAP system of the course ADM110.

questions.question: In which phase can you revise the parameters value during the SAP Solution Manager system installation?
questions.why: You can revise the parameters value during the SAP Solution Manager system installation during the Parameter Summary phase. Read more on this in the lesson Installing an SAP Solution Manager ABAP system of the course ADM110.

questions.question: For which kernel components will you potentially be asked to provide current archives during installation? (3)
questions.why: SAPinst will ask you for the location of SAPEXE.SAR, SAPEXEDB.SAR, SAPHOSTAGENT.SAR and two more IGS-related archives. A current SAPCAR version needs to be downloaded separately, if required, whereas icmadmin.SAR is contained in dw.SAR, which is an archive that provides some specific kernel components but that cannot be used during installation. Read more on this in the lesson Installing an SAP Solution Manager ABAP system of the course ADM110.

questions.question: When installing an SAP system, you can start SAPinst to install Primary Application Server, ABAP Central Services Instance and one or several Additional Application Servers in one go. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: The installation of an Addition Application Server requires a separate execution of SAPinst. Read more on this in the lesson Installing an SAP Solution Manager ABAP system of the course ADM110.

questions.question: During the installation of an SAP Solution Manager ABAP system, you are required to set the user IDs for some user management engine (UME) users stored in the ABAP system. Identify the accounts, for which you need to provide user IDs. (2)
questions.why: During the installation of an SAP Solution Manager ABAP system, you are required to set the user IDs for the accounts Administrator User, Guest User and Communication User. It is not required to provide a database user or an SLD user for the UME during the installation. Read more on this in the lesson Installing an SAP Solution Manager ABAP system of the course ADM110.

questions.question: When the database is running in a mode where it does not write any change logs, data can be restored to:

options.text: a specific date and time (point in time recovery)

questions.why: When the database is running in a mode where it does not write any change logs, data can be restored to the last full backup. Read more on this in the lesson Identifying Initial Post Installation Steps of the course ADM110.

questions.question: After installing an SAP system (not an SAP S/4HANA Server system) you should schedule standard background jobs. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: The scheduling of standard background jobs is a recommended post-installation activity. Read more on this in the lesson Identifying Initial Post-Installation Steps of the course ADM110.

questions.question: You configure the Transport Management System (TMS) in a freshly installed SAP system running on AS ABAP 7.4 and above. What will be done (by the system) during the initial setup of TMS? (3)

options.text: The user SUPPORT will be created
The user TMSADM will be created
The transport directory will be created
The system description needs to be provided

questions.why: The user TMSADM will be created and you are required to decide on the password for this user and you will define the description for the system. There is no user SUPPORT created and the transport directory will be created/provided during the installation. Read more on this in the lesson Preparing the Training System for an Software Update of the course ADM110.

questions.question: In which client is the initial set up of TMS done?
questions.why: The initial set up of TMS is done in client 000. Read more on this in lesson Preparing the Training System for an Software Update of the course ADM110.

questions.question: The standard background jobs are configured in the same way, whether you configure the jobs for an SAP S/4HANA Server or for a non-SAP S/4HANA Server system that is based on AS ABAP. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: The scheduling of standard background jobs is done differently for an SAP S/4HANA Server system than for other AS ABAP-based SAP systems. Read more on this in the lesson Preparing the Training System for an Software Update of the course ADM110.

questions.question: For which scenarios can you use the SAProuter? (2)

options.text: Enabling SAP support to log on to your SAP system
Restricting from which PCs users can log on to which SAP systems
Setting up an auto logout for unused user sessions
Enabling single sign on to multiple SAP systems

questions.why: The SAProuter can be used for enabling SAP support to log on to your SAP system and for restricting from which PCs users can log on to which SAP systems. Read more on this in the lesson Configuring SAP License, Operation Modes, SAProuter of the course ADM110.

questions.question: After installation of the PAS, no user can log on to the SAP system until a permanent license is installed. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: After installation of the PAS, a temporary license is active for four weeks. During this time, users can log on to the SAP system. Read more on this in the lesson Configuring SAP License, Operation Modes, SAProuter of the course ADM110.

questions.question: What are use cases of SAProuter? (3)

options.text: Determine the language version of the online help displays
Offering customers access to the SAP Help Portal

questions.why: SAProuter increases network security and simplifies network configuration. SAProuter is required for remote support connections. Read more on this in the lesson Configuring SAP License, Operation Modes, SAProuter of the course ADM110.

questions.question: What are the steps needed to install additional languages? (3)

options.text: Supplementing of periodic language for newly generated texts

questions.why: We need to classify the language, schedule language transport or import, and schedule language supplementation to install additional languages. Read more on this in lesson Describing Installation Check, Additional Languages, Business Functions of the Course ADM110.

questions.question: When you use the SAP Initial Consistency Check, which checks will be executed? (3)

options.text: Security of passwords of users SAP* and DDIC
Version Compatibility between SAP release and operating system
Write access regarding the transport directory

questions.why: The SAP Initial Consistency Check will check the version Compatibility between SAP release and operating system, the accessibility of the message server and will collect information about the enqueue service among other checks. It doesn't check the security of passwords for SAP* and DDIC, and it also doesn't check write access regarding the transport directory. Read more on this in the lesson Describing Installation Check, Additional Languages, Business Functions of the course ADM110.

questions.question: When defining a task list within the Task Manager for Technical Configuration, you can select between several hundred predefined steps to include into your own task list. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: The Task Manager for Technical Configuration offers several hundred predefined steps that you can include into your own task list definition. Read more on this in the lesson Using Automated Setup of an AS ABAP-based SAP System of the course ADM110.

questions.question: Identify characteristics of the SAP NetWeaver Administrator tool. (2)

options.text: Is used as a standalone tool outside the SAP system
Requires logon with the user J2EE_ADMIN
Allows access to the Configuration Wizard
Is being accessed via a web browser interface

questions.why: SAP NetWeaver Administrator needs to be accessed via a web browser and allows access to the Configuration Wizard. You use any sufficiently authorized user to log on to the SAP NetWeaver Administrator and it is fully embedded into AS Java - meaning when the AS Java is stopped, SAP NetWeaver Administrator can't be used. Read more on this in the lesson Configuring an AS Java-based SAP System of the course ADM110.

questions.question: Several components of SAP Systems can be patched using Software Update Manager (SUM). Which components of AS ABAP-based SAP systems can be updated using SUM? (3)
questions.why: Kernel, SPAM/SAINT and SAP_BASIS can be updated using SUM. Read more on this in the lesson Patching SAP Systems from the course ADM110.

questions.question: Which content of an SAP system can be updated with an SAP Support Package? (3)
questions.why: An SAP Note can update ABAP programs, table structures, and data. Read more on this in the lesson Patching SAP Systems of the course ADM110.

questions.question: What should you do before updating your SAP system using SUM? (2)

options.text: Download the latest version of SUM
Download the latest version of Software Provisioning Manager (SWPM)
Change the password for user DDIC in client 000
Read the corresponding SAP Note for your version of SUM

questions.why: Before updating your SAP system using SUM, download the latest version of SUM and read the corresponding SAP Note for your version of SUM. Read more on this in the lesson Updating an SAP S/4HANA Server System using SUM, Strategy Standard of the course ADM110.

questions.question: When updating an SAP S/4HANA Server system using Software Update Manager (SUM), you will be asked for the passwords for which users? (2)

options.text: SYSTEM in SAP HANA Tenant database

questions.why: When updating an SAP S/4HANA Server system using SUM, you will be asked for the passwords of DDIC in client 000 and SYSTEM in the SAP HANA Tenant database - but the passwords for the users SAP* in client 000 or TMSADM in the same client are not required. Read more on this in the lesson Updating an SAP S/4HANA Server System using SUM, Strategy Standard of the course ADM110.

questions.question: When working with Software Update Manager (SUM) you should activate an Expert Mode that allows additional settings. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: SUM offers an expert mode that offers additional settings to be used during the update. Read more on this in the lesson Updating an SAP S/4HANA Server System using SUM, Strategy Standard of the course ADM110.

questions.question: Identify activities that you should complete before executing an update of your SAP system using Software Update Manager (SUM). Which activities can make updating your SAP system easier, if executed in advance? (3)

options.text: Read and follow the corresponding SAP Notes for the version of SUM you will be using
Check for modifications that might require attention during the update
Execute SAP Load Generator before starting the update
Check available disk space and free space in the database

questions.why: Among other recommended activities, you should check the corresponding SAP Note for prerequisites, you should check your system for modifications and you should check the available disk space and free space in the database. Executing the SAP Load Generator is an activity that you will execute after updating your SAP system. Read more on this in the lesson Updating an SAP S/4HANA Server System using SUM, Strategy Standard of the course ADM110.

questions.question: Importing SAP Support Packages in an AS ABAP based SAP system using the Software Update Manager (SUM) requires that you provide a so-called stack-XML file at the begin of the update process. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: When importing SAP Support Packages in an AS ABAP-based SAP system you are required to provide a so-called stack-XML file. Read more on this in the lesson Updating an SAP S/4HANA Server System using SUM, Strategy Standard of the course ADM110.

questions.question: You are using the strategy Standard for updating an AS ABAP-based SAP system. This will result in lower required free space in the database than when using the strategy Single System. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: Using the strategy Standard for updating an AS ABAP-based SAP system will result in higher required free space in the database than when using the strategy Single System. Read more on this in the lesson Updating an SAP S/4HANA Server System using SUM, Strategy Standard of the course ADM110.

questions.question: Immediately after a new installation, all ABAP programs are available as source code including their load. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: Immediately after a new installation, all ABAP programs are available as source code only. You can use transaction SGEN to generate the ABAP loads of a number of programs, function groups, and classes after installation. Read more on this in the lesson Generating new Program Loads using SGEN of the course ADM110.

questions.question: You use the SAP Load Generator to generate loads in your SAP system which consists of applications servers running on Linux and another Unix operating system. To generate all selected loads for all application servers, you need to start the load generation more than once. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: Loads are platform-specific, therefore you need to start the Load Generator as often as your system uses different OS-platforms. Read more on this in the lesson Generating new Program Loads using SGEN of the course ADM110.

questions.question: You are installing an SAP Solution Manager Java system. What is the minimum number of Java Server Nodes that you can set during the installation?

options.text: The minimum number is equal to the number of CPU cores available on the server used for installation

questions.why: The SAP Solution Manager Java system requires at least one Java Server Node. Read more on this in the lesson Installing an SAP Solution Manager Java System of the course ADM110.

questions.question: On the installation dialog screens relating to the installation of an Additional Application Server for an SAP S/4HANA Server system, you are required to provide the profile directory of the SAP system. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: During the installation of an Additional Application Server for an SAP S/4HANA Server system, you are required to provide the profile directory of the SAP system. Read more on this in the lesson Installing an AAS for an SAP S/4HANA Server system of the course ADM110.

questions.question: You are installing an SAP S/4HANA Server system that should use an Enqueue Replication Server (ERS). How do you install the ERS?

options.text: The installation of an ERS is optionally included within the installation of the ABAP Central Services Instance (ASCS)
The installation of an ERS is automatically included into the installation of the Primary Application Server
The installation of an ERS needs to be executed by a dedicated run of SAPinst
The installation of an ERS is mandatory included within the installation of the ABAP Central Services Instance (ASCS)

questions.why: The optional installation of an ERS needs to be executed by a dedicated run of SAPinst. Read more on this in the lesson Installing an ERS for an SAP S/4HANA System of the course ADM110.

questions.question: You are installing an AS ABAP-based SAP system. Identify the SAP System IDs that are allowed, according to the corresponding naming conventions. (2)
questions.why: According to the rules, the SAP system ID must consist of three alphanumeric characters, only uppercase letters are allowed, the first character must be a letter and the subsequent characters may be letters or digits. Some SIDs are not allowed, among them, the SID SAP.

questions.question: What is the tool inside SWPM for an installation?
questions.why: SAPinst is the tool inside SWPM. Read more on this in the lesson Installing an SAP System Using Software Provisioning Manager (SWPM) of the course ADM110.

questions.question: Which file records all the notifications of every installation step?
questions.why: The sapinst_dev.log records all the notifications of every installation step. Read more on this in lesson Installing an SAP System Using SAPinst of the course ADM110.

questions.question: Using the browser-based interface of SAPinst you can directly access important log files created during the installation process. Decide if true or false. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: The browser-based interface of SAPinst allows access to important log files written during the installation process. Read more on this in the lesson Installing an SAP system Using SAPinst of the course ADM110.

questions.question: Before starting the installation of an SAP system, consider the following information source:
questions.why: Before starting the installation of an SAP system, consider the Installation Guide as an information source. Read more on this in the lesson Preparing for the Installation of the course ADM110.

questions.question: Which characteristics help you to identify the exact installation guide document that you should use during the installation process? (3)

options.text: Release of the SAP software to be installed
Operating system that will be used
Database Software that will be used
Hardware Type that will be used
Virtualization Technique that will be used

questions.why: Besides release of the SAP software to be installed, the operating system to be used and the database software to be used, the type of SAP software (AS ABAP-based or AS Java-based) plays a role in identifying the fitting installation guide. The hardware type and the virtualization technique used are not selection criteria when searching for the correct installation guide document. Read more on this in the lesson Preparing for the Installation of the course ADM110.

questions.question: Which of the following Windows-specific preparations are performed when installing an SAP system on a Windows operating system? (2)
questions.why: The Windows-specific preparations which are performed when installing an SAP system on a Windows operating system are Check Windows file system and Prepare installation user. Read more on this in the lesson Preparing the OS for an Installation of an SAP System of the course ADM110.

questions.question: Which condition does the user used for installing an SAP system on Windows need to fulfill?

options.text: Needs to be named SapServicesSID (SID being replaced by the chosen SID of the system to be installed
Needs to be named sapSID (SID being replaced by the chosen SID of the system to be installed)
Needs to have local administrator rights

questions.why: The user used for installing an SAP system on Windows needs to have local administrator rights. The name can be chosen freely with the exception of the names SAPServiceSID and sapSID (SID being replaced by the chosen SID of the system to be installed). Read more on this in the lesson Preparing the OS for an Installation of an SAP System of the course ADM110.

questions.question: Which file system paths can you find in an AS ABAP 7.5 (or higher) - based SAP system on Unix, right after a standard installation? (SID being replaced by the chosen SID of the system to be installed) (2)
questions.why: The directories /usr/sap/trans and /usr/sap/SID/SYS will be created by the installer when installing an AS ABAP 7.5 (or higher) -based SAP system on Unix, whereas the directory name /usr/sap/SID/DVEBMGS is incomplete (instance number missing) and is no longer used when installing AS ABAP 7.5 (or higher) and the directory /usr/sap/SID/SCS will only be created when installing an AS Java-based SAP system. Read more on this in the lesson Preparing for the Installation of an SAP System on UNIX of the course ADM110.

questions.question: An ASCS is a prerequisite for an ERS. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: An ASCS is a prerequisite for an ERS. Read more on this in the lesson Managing an Enqueue Replication Server (ERS) of the course ADM110.

questions.question: You installed an Enqueue Replication Server (ERS) for your SAP system. It is recommended that you configure a dynamic work process of type E (Enqueue) as a fallback safeguard against a failure of the ERS. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: In AS ABAP-based SAP systems using an ERS, you are not allowed to use enqueue work processes at any time. Read more on this in the lesson Managing an Enqueue Replication Server (ERS) of the course ADM110.

questions.question: What is the main task of spool work processes?
questions.why: A spool work process creates output requests, based on spool requests. Spool requests and spool data can be created, for example, by dialog work processes.

questions.question: Which of the following access methods exist in AS ABAP-based SAP systems? (3)
questions.why: Instance printing does not exist.

questions.question: Identify features of using logical spool servers. (2)

options.text: Make spool work processes available across different SAP systems.

questions.why: Logical spool servers allow failover functions and load balancing. Spool work processes cannot be made available across different SAP systems and logical spool servers also don't allow an enhanced authorization concept.

questions.question: Which transaction provides an overview of important spool reports and transactions?
questions.why: Transaction SPOOL provides an overview of important spool reports and transactions. Transaction SPAD can be used to create output devices and logical spool servers. Transaction SP01 provides an overview of spool requests and output requests.

questions.question: Where should you store the TemSe if you focus on data consistency rather than on performance?

options.text: In the database, table TST03 (rspo_store_location = db)
On file system level, directory /usr/sap/<SID>/SYS/global (rspo_store_location = G)
On file system level, directory /usr/sap/<SID>/<instance>/data (rspo_store_location = L)

questions.why: When you decide to store the TemSe in the database (rspo_store_location = db), TemSe data is saved using regular DB backups and the database keeps the various spool /TemSe tables consistent when restoring them. When you store TemSe on file system level (rspo_store_location = G or L), access to it is usually much faster than accessing to the database.

questions.question: What can be executed as a job step? (3)
questions.why: You can use an ABAP program, an external command or an external program as a job step.

questions.question: What status can a job have? (3)
questions.why: A job can have the status Released, Finished, and Active. In addition to the three correct answers, a job can also have status Planned, Ready, and Canceled. Read more on this in the lesson "Explaining Background Processing".

questions.question: If one of the system's ten background work processes is reserved for class A jobs, and jobs are being processed in the other nine work processes, the reserved work process remains free even if a class A job is waiting for execution. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: The work processes that are reserved for class A jobs process class A jobs. The option to reserve work processes for class A jobs should only prevent all work processes being occupied with class B or C jobs.

questions.question: Which of the listed options for time-dependent scheduling of a job can be implemented with the standard resources of the SAP system? (5)

options.text: The second-last working day of every month
Every nine days, but not on Sundays

questions.why: You can implement all the options mentioned with standard AS ABAP tools.

questions.question: Which of the listed options for event-dependent scheduling of a job can be implemented with the standard resources of the SAP system (AS ABAP)? (3)

options.text: Whenever the system switches to the Night operation mode
Whenever a particular event has been triggered
Whenever the periodic Job2 has run successfully

questions.why: Option D cannot be implemented directly in the standard system. An enhancement to the standard system, for example, with function modules or using SAP Central Process Scheduling (SAP CPS), can also implement this option, as well as many others.

questions.question: Which product has been built entirely new on the SAP HANA platform and designed with SAP Fiori user experience?

options.text: SAP Business Suite on SAP HANA
SAP Business Suite for SAP HANA (SAP S/4HANA)

questions.why: SAP S/4HANA is the next generation of the SAP Business Suite. It has been built entirely new on the SAP HANA platform and designed with SAP Fiori user experience. SAP Business Suite on SAP HANA means that you run classical SAP applications (such as SAP ERP) on the SAP HANA database.

questions.question: An Intelligent, Sustainable Enterprise consists of several areas. Which of the following are part of an Intelligent, Sustainable Enterprise? (2)
questions.why: The Intelligent Sustainable Enterprise consists of: Business Processes, Applications, Technology and Infrastructure.

questions.question: The three key end-to-end scenarios of the SAP BTP are Integration, Data-to-Value an Extensibility. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: SAP Business Technology Platform consists of three main scenarios: Integration, Data-to-Value, Extensibility.

questions.question: Which (process) layers exist in client/server-based SAP systems (such as SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA Server)? (3)
questions.why: Client/server-based SAP systems consist of a presentation layer, an application layer, and the database layer.

questions.question: What are the advantages of a three-tier client/server configuration compared to a single-tier or two-tier configuration? (2)
questions.why: Implementing an additional hardware layer for application processes makes it easier to adapt an SAP system if the number of users changes (scalability), and to assign user groups to specific application servers (software-oriented view), (load balancing). The additional hardware layer does not, however, reduce the administrative workload.

questions.question: You can only work in one window (session) at a time in an SAP system. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: Within one log on, it is possible to work in several windows (sessions) in parallel.

questions.question: Which of the following statements accurately describes a client in an AS ABAP-based SAP system? (2)

options.text: A client represents a completely independent business entity.
A client has its own database.
A client corresponds to a customer.
A client may represent an entire company.

questions.why: The data for all clients in an SAP system is stored within a single common database. This data is nevertheless divided by clients so that different companies can be administered and controlled in different clients. A client is not a customer within an SAP system.

questions.question: Which of the following strings are valid entries in the Command field? (5)
questions.why: Entering /n in front of a transaction code ends the actual transaction and starts the new transaction in the same session. From the SAP Easy Access screen, you may also enter the transaction code directly.

questions.question: With the help of SAP GUI for HTML, you can log on to both AS ABAP-based SAP systems and AS Java-based SAP systems. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: SAP GUI for HTML can be used to log on to AS ABAP-based SAP systems, only. SAP GUI for HTML is not available for AS Java-based SAP systems.

questions.question: Which versions of SAP Business Client are available? (2)
questions.why: SAP Business Client provides users with a local client with role-based navigation. It is available as SAP Business Client for HTML (intended for normal users) and as SAP Business Client for Windows (intended for power users).

questions.question: Which AS ABAP process receives the user request? (Choose the correct answer.)
questions.why: The ABAP dispatcher receives the user request on the AS ABAP and passes it on to an available work process. The SAP presentation program, SAP GUI, is not part of the application server (software-oriented view), and the server process is an AS Java process.

questions.question: Which work process types are there in an AS ABAP-based SAP system? (4)
questions.why: All of the above processes can in theory be configured in an AS ABAP-based SAP system. However, not all of the above processes are work processes. The message server and ICM process are not work processes.

questions.question: Which process enables an AS ABAP-based SAP system to communicate using the HTTP and SMTP protocols?
questions.why: The ICM supports communication using the protocols HTTP(S) and SMTP. The Message Server does not support SMTP and the Gateway is used for RFC-based communication.

questions.question: Which tool combines the most important administration and monitoring tools for AS Java-based SAP systems in a browser-based user interface?
questions.why: SAP NetWeaver Administrator (NWA) combines the most important administration and monitoring tools for AS Java-based SAP systems in a browser-based user interface. The Config Tool enables the offline configuration of the cluster elements of Java. The Visual Administrator is a graphic user interface (GUI) that enables the administration of all Java cluster elements. As of AS Java 7.10, it has been replaced by SAP NWA. SAP Computing Center Management System offers tools for the administration and monitoring of AS ABAP-based SAP systems.

questions.question: Which data can be stored in a client?

options.text: Cross-client-customizing, user data, and application data
Client-specific customizing, user data, and application data
Only user data that was entered in this client

questions.why: A client contains client-specific customizing, user data, and application data.

questions.question: At the end of the development project, the tasks and transport requests must be released so that they can be exported. Who releases what here? (2)

options.text: The development project lead releases the entire transport request.
The system automatically releases the transport request once all tasks are released.

questions.why: First, all developers release their own tasks. Then the development project lead can release the entire transport request. The release of the transport request is not performed automatically.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a domain in the context of the ABAP Dictionary? (Choose the correct answers.)

options.text: For defining the technical attributes of a field.
For including a foreign key dependency.
For defining the semantic attributes of a field.
For entering data in a table.

questions.why: You use domains for defining the technical attributes of fields in a table. The semantic attributes of a field are defined in the data element.

questions.question: Which tools are included in the ABAP Workbench? (3)
questions.why: Object Navigator, Function Builder, and Screen Painter are part of the ABAP Workbench. SAP Reference IMG, however, is a customizing tool.

questions.question: How are authorizations assigned to a user? (2)

options.text: Users are assigned authorizations using profiles.
Users are assigned authorizations using roles.
Users are assigned authorizations using user names.
Users are assigned authorizations by a certification authority (CA).

questions.why: Authorizations are grouped together in profiles. The roles assigned to users contain profiles with appropriate authorizations for the role. Authorizations are not assigned using user names or a CA.

questions.question: Users of which types are able to log on to an AS ABAP using SAP GUI? (2)
questions.why: Users of type Dialog and Service are able to use SAP GUI to log on to an AS ABAP. Users of type Communication and System are not allowed to log on to an AS ABAP using SAP GUI. Read more on this in the lesson "Creating, Copying, and Maintaining User Master Records".

questions.question: Identify the restrictions that you can set with regard to passwords in AS ABAP. (3)

options.text: User is not allowed to change password
Password needs to be changed during each logon, except when using single sign-on
Number of failed logons until user becomes locked

questions.why: You can use parameters to define the minimum password length, the password expiration time, the number of failed logons until user becomes locked. You cannot disallow the user from changing the password, also you cannot force a password change during each logon. Read more on this in the lesson "Defining Login Parameters and Using the User Information System".

questions.question: Which of the following data sources are supported by the UME: (3)
questions.why: These three types of data source are available for the UME.

questions.question: You can lock users with the Identity Management tool. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: The Identity Management allows you to administer users.

questions.question: You can assign permissions directly to users in the Identity Management. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: Permissions are combined into actions, and the administrator then combines these into roles. UME roles can be assigned to a user.

questions.question: The term JEE security role is another name for a UME role. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: A JEE security role is part of the JEE standard and is mostly used for a declarative authorization check. A UME role is an (SAP) extension to the JEE standard and is used for a programmable authorization check.

questions.question: If the emergency user (SAP*) is activated, the administration user (Administrator, J2EE_ADMIN, or J2EE_ADMIN_<SID>) can also log onto SAP NetWeaver AS Java. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: If the emergency user SAP* is activated then no other users can log onto SAP NetWeaver AS Java.

questions.question: Which interfaces or communication options are supported by SAP systems? (4)
questions.why: From an SAP system, you can communicate with other systems using, for example, HTTP, SMTP, RFC, or BAPIs. XDTP and STP do not exist.

questions.question: What can BAPIs be used for? (3)

options.text: Request data from an SAP system
Pass data to an SAP system
Transfer SAP screen images to third-party applications (such as Microsoft Word)
Access business processes in SAP systems

questions.why: You can use BAPIs to access business processes in an SAP system and to request and transfer data between SAP systems. GUI functions cannot be transferred to third-party products with the help of BAPIs.

questions.question: You access BAPIs in SAP systems using an RFC interface. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: BAPIs are nothing other than special, remote-enabled function modules. They can therefore also be addressed using RFCs.

questions.question: What is the purpose of Application Link Enabling (ALE)? (2)

options.text: To provide a platform for the development of SAP-based applications.
To exchange application data between collaborating companies, using certain formats and technologies.
To communicate between different production systems of your system landscape.
To transport software changes from the development system to the production system.

questions.why: ALE is a very powerful method of exchanging client-specific data (such as application data) between different systems. These systems may be located within the same company, or they may be distributed between several companies. The data is transferred by RFC in a previously-defined format. The transfer type may be synchronous or asynchronous.

questions.question: Which dimensions define SAP Fiori? (3)
questions.why: The following dimensions define SAP Fiori: Design, Principles, and Technology.

questions.question: What are the main principles of SAP Fiori? (5)
questions.why: All the above are the main principles of SAP Fiori.

questions.question: Which clients can be used for SAP Fiori? (2)
questions.why: The following clients can be used in SAP Fiori: Web browser and SAP Business Client.

questions.question: Which platforms support the integration of SAP Fiori? (3)
questions.why: The following platforms support the integration of SAP Fiori: SAP Enterprise Portal, SAP Build Work Zone, and SAP Mobile Services.

questions.question: Which personalization elements can be assigned to user roles? (3)
questions.why: The following personalization elements can be assigned to user roles: SAP Fiori group, space, and catalog.

questions.question: Which element has the application as target?
questions.why: The SAP Fiori app descriptor has the application as target.

questions.question: Of which sections does the SAP Fiori My Home consist? (4)
questions.why: The SAP Fiori My Home consists of the sections To-Dos, News and Pages, Apps, and Insights Tiles and Cards.

questions.question: How can you add apps to the SAP Fiori My Home? (2)
questions.why: You can add apps from the app finder and other pages to the SAP Fiori My Home.

questions.question: Which SAP Fiori themes change the structure of ABAP transactions automatically? (3)
questions.why: SAP Belize, Quartz, and Horizon change the structure of ABAP transactions automatically.

questions.question: What are the app types of SAP Fiori? (3)
questions.why: The SAP Fiori app types are: Transactional, Analytical, and Fact Sheet.

questions.question: Which apps are meant by the term classic applications? (2)
questions.why: ABAP transactions and Web Dynpro ABAP applications are meant to be the term classic applications.

questions.question: Which layers of settings are available for SAP Fiori? (3)
questions.why: The following layers of settings are available for SAP Fiori: Configuration, Personalization, and Customizing.

questions.question: Which elements of SAP Fiori can be assigned to business roles? (3)
questions.why: Business catalogs, business catalog groups, and spaces can be assigned to business roles.

questions.question: Tools for managing SAP Fiori spaces and pages are provided in the SAP Fiori launchpad designer. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: Tools for managing SAP Fiori spaces and pages are provided in the SAP Fiori launchpad.

questions.question: How many spaces should be assigned to a business role according to the best practices?
questions.why: Only one space should be assigned to a business role.

questions.question: Which element groups SAP Fiori apps based on solution area?
questions.why: A technical catalog groups SAP Fiori apps based on solution area.

questions.question: Which element groups SAP Fiori apps based on business duty?
questions.why: A business catalog groups SAP Fiori apps based on business duty.

questions.question: For intent-based navigation, what does an intent consist of? (2)
questions.why: For intent-based navigation, an intent consists of: Semantic Object and Action.

questions.question: What can be used as a target in a target mapping? (4)
questions.why: All the above can be used as target in a target mapping.

questions.question: Why is monitoring important in business processes?

options.text: To ensure the efficient processing of business processes.
To increase the number of users accessing the system.
To minimize the cost of software licenses.
To promote the use of outdated technologies.

questions.why: Monitoring is crucial for the efficient processing of business processes. It allows administrators to identify and rectify issues before they escalate, ensuring overall productivity and system stability.

questions.question: Which of the following options are available for tracing and logging in the SAP system?
questions.why: All the listed options are available for tracing and logging in the SAP system. Each of these options plays a vital role in monitoring system performance, isolating problems, and understanding system behaviors.

questions.question: What can you do with transaction RZ20?

options.text: Monitor the database and the SAP system

questions.why: You can use system monitoring in transaction RZ20 to monitor SAP systems and their databases. Read more on this in unit 10 of the course ADM100.

questions.question: With which of the following transactions can you activate a trace for SQL statements in the SAP system (SQL trace)? (2)
questions.why: You can analyze SQL statements by activating the trace in transaction ST01 (system trace) or ST05 (performance analysis). Transaction SM21 (SysLog) is the system log. The DBA COCKPIT lets you analyze the database in great detail, but does not feature an SQL trace. Read more on this in unit 10 of the course ADM100.

questions.question: Where is the information on the current state of the SAP system, shown in transaction RZ20, stored?

options.text: In files on operating system level.
In local memory of the work processes.

questions.why: The information shown in transaction RZ20 on the current system status is being stored in the monitoring segment. Read more on this in the lesson "Using the Monitoring Architecture of the Computing Center Management System" of the course ADM110.

questions.question: What components does SAP Solution Manager use to collect monitoring data? (2)
questions.why: SAP Solution Manager uses, among others, the diagnostics agent and CA Introscope to collect monitoring data. SAP Web Dispatcher and SAP MC are not used by SAP Solution Manager to collect monitoring data. Read more on this in the lesson "Explaining the Concept of Monitoring Tools in SAP Solution Manager" of the course ADM100.

questions.question: Identify functions in the AS ABAP that aim at analyzing error situations. (3)
questions.why: The System Log, the Dump Analysis and the System Trace can help you to analyze error situations in AS ABAP. The Event Log is a function of the operating system Windows and transaction SNOTE can be used to remedy software errors, but it can't be used for analysis. Read more on this in the lesson "Tracing and Logging in the SAP System" of the course ADM100.

questions.question: When you encounter an error situation in an SAP system, it is recommended that you involve SAP Support as soon as possible. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
