questions.why: Usually, SAP recommends that you use the tools and functions at your disposal to try to solve the situation yourself. Read more on this in the lesson "Troubleshooting Procedures" of the course ADM100.

questions.question: Which actions are possible using the Monitor Browser in the NWA? (2)

options.text: Display monitoring data for Java instances

questions.why: The tasks of the Monitor Browser are to change threshold values, and display collected monitoring data.

questions.question: In which client of the AS ABAP system has to be done the registration to the AS Java system?
questions.why: The registration has to be done from client 000 of the AS ABAP system.

questions.question: What is a key technical prerequisite for implementing Monitoring and Alerting Infrastructure (MAI)?

options.text: The use of a Java-based application server.
Configuration of the SAP Host Agent.
Development of a custom diagnostics agent.
Full integration with third-party monitoring tools.

questions.why: The configuration of the SAP Host Agent is a vital prerequisite for implementing Monitoring and Alerting Infrastructure (MAI). It serves as a basic building block for integrating monitored systems within the MAI framework.

questions.question: Who is SAP for Me tailored for? (2)

options.text: Everyone who is interested in SAP

questions.why: SAP for Me is tailored for SAP customers and SAP partners.

questions.question: What is the main capability of SAP Help Portal?

options.text: To optimize your SAP license contracts
To search for product help for SAP products

questions.why: The main capability of SAP Help Portal is to search for product help for SAP products.

questions.question: Besides many more, what can be accessed in SAP Community? (2)
questions.why: Besides many more, in SAP Community you can access technical articles and reviews and the SAP Wiki.

questions.question: What can SAP Road Map Explorer be utilized for?

options.text: To check operating system and database restrictions of SAP products
To download add-ons for SAP products
To search and view planned features of SAP products

questions.why: SAP Road Map Explorer can be utilized to search and view planned features of SAP products.

questions.question: What are the two main capabilities of SAP Discovery Center? (2)
questions.why: The two main capabilities of SAP Discovery Center are the Services and the Missions.

questions.question: What are two capabilities of SAP Learning Offerings? (2)
questions.why: Two capabilities of SAP Learning Offerings are to see the course descriptions and obtain course dates.

questions.question: The profile directory of an ABAP-based SAP system on operating system level can be accessed by any instance with an assigned 2-digit number, which is part of this SAP system. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: The profile directory can be accessed by any instance with an assigned 2-digit number of one and the same SAP system on operating system level and is located underneath the <SAPSID> and then the SYS directory.

questions.question: The ABAP Central Services (ASCS) instance can be started successfully, even if the database of the SAP system is not yet up-and-running. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: The ASCS instance can be started successfully even if the database of the SAP system was not yet started.

questions.question: Which of the following instances does not have an assigned enqueue server or enqueue process?
questions.why: Instances with priority LEVEL 1 and priority LEVEL 2 have an assigned enqueue server or enqueue process. Only an instance with priority LEVEL 3 does not have an assigned enqueue server or process.

questions.question: Every sapstartsrv of one ABAP-based SAP system reads every existing instance profile of the respective SAP system. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: The sapstartsrv is instance-specific and reads only the instance profile of the own instance. In addition it reads also the default profile.

questions.question: The stop action of an ABAP-based SAP system is performed in the following way regarding priorities:

options.text: The system stop action is done in the same order as the system start action.
The system stop action is done in the reverse order in comparison to the system start action.
The system stop action is done in any order. The order to stop the instances does not matter.

questions.why: When stopping an ABAP-based SAP system, the reverse start order is used. Instances with a high number (low priority) are stopped first. Then, successively the other instances are stopped.

questions.question: Which of the following tasks is important before stopping an ABAP-based SAP system?

options.text: Inform users beforehand and check user sessions right before stopping

questions.why: Users have to be informed about the shutdown beforehand, for example by creating a system message via transaction SM02. In addition it should be verified directly before the shutdown, whether users are still logged on. It is not necessary to check for finished jobs, but for jobs in status active or scheduled. And even the execution of a database backup is not needed.

questions.question: Which of the following statements are true regarding the usage and the structure of the SAP Management Console (SAP MC)? (2)

options.text: The SAP MC has to be installed explicitly by the customer
The structure of the SAP MC can be adjusted
The content of the SAP MC can be defined by the customer individually
The SAP MC is operating system independent

questions.why: There is no need to install the SAP MC. It comes with the SAP kernel. Customers are able to defined the content (SAP systems and instances), but the structure cannot be maintained. The software of the SAP MC is a Java application and operating system independent.

questions.question: Which of the following functions is provided in the context menu of an <SAPSID> in the Navigation Pane of the SAP MC?
questions.why: Based on an <SAPSID>, the function provided in the context menu is Restart.... Depending on the current status of the SAP system, also other functions are provided. For example Start... or Stop.... There are no functions like reinstall or reinitialize. Only a Remove of the <SAPSID> from the SAP MC is provided.

questions.question: SAPControl provides features and functions for starting and stopping. Flag the correct answers regarding the usage of this tool in combination with ABAP-based SAP systems. (3)

options.text: With SAPControl complete ABAP-based SAP systems can be started, without pushing every instance explicitly.
SAPControl uses webmethods to execute functions.
SAPControl always needs the specification of user and password to execute a function.
SAPControl can be used interactively on command line level.

questions.why: SAPControl is able to start complete SAP systems with only one command as a webmethod. These are functions used by the tool. Depending on the operating system user used to execute webmethods and depending on the configuration, the authentication is done without providing user and password.

questions.question: Identify the directory in which you can find many relevant logs related to the startup of an SAP system (identify the directory structure that recently installed SAP systems will use)?
questions.why: The work directory holds the most important log files related to the startup of an SAP system. The other listed directories store other information.

questions.question: Which of the following areas - beside the sap log and trace files - might most probably provide further useful detailed log and trace information, in case the ASCS instance of your ABAP-based SAP system started successful, but the PAS and AAS instances did not come up?

options.text: The syslog of the operating system where the ASCS instance is installed.
Error log files from the underlying database.
The log file of the SAP GUI.

questions.why: If the database-independent ASCS instance was started without problems, but the PAS/AAS instances not, there is a high probability that the underlying database is not operational. But there can be also lots of others reasons for this problematic.

questions.question: Snapshots provide useful log and trace information in the format of an archive. Which tools can be used to access these archives? (3)

options.text: Transaction SNAPSHOTS, for example, using SAP GUI.

questions.why: To access or even create or delete snapshots, multiple tools can be used. The SAP MC, SAPControl on command line level, and transaction SNAPSHOTS using for example SAP GUI. Nevertheless, the operating system syslog cannot handle snapshots.

questions.question: When starting an AS Java-based SAP system, the database is always started after the AS Java instances (PAS/AAS). Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: The database is always started before the PAS or AAS, or must be available before these instances are started. The Central Services instance can be started before the database. The Central Services instance can also be started after the database, for example if the database is already running.

questions.question: Which profiles should exist for an AS Java-based SAP system with the <SID> JAV, which is installed on one central host exhost and covering instances starting with number 30? (3)
questions.why: For Java Instances the prefix "J" is used and the Central Services Instance uses prefix "SCS". In ABAP environments "D" and "ASCS" is used.

questions.question: In the case of an AS Java-based SAP system, it is not possible to stop individual instances under a UNIX operating system. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: You can stop individual instances using the command line tool SAPControl or simply using the SAP MC.

questions.question: The most important trace and log files of an AS Java-based SAP system are stored in the work directory of each instance, that is, for example under /usr/sap/<SID>/J<instance no.>/work. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: All developer traces and all important start files are stored in the work directory of each instance.

questions.question: In which sequence does the system read the system parameters from the specified locations?

options.text: In which sequence does the system read the system parameters from the specified locations?
1. start.ini 2. Kernel 3. Default profile 4. Instance profile
1. Kernel 2. start.ini 3. Default profile 4. Instance profile

questions.why: There is no file called start.ini involved in this context; it was made up.

questions.question: Bring the different sources for configuration information used during the startup of an AS ABAP-based instance into the correct chronological sequence.
questions.why: An AS ABAP-based instance first reads variables from the environment, then it evaluates the kernel default values followed by the default profile and the instance profile. Read more on this in the lesson "Understanding the Parameter Evaluation Sequence" of the course ADM100.

questions.question: In what profile should you change the number of background work processes?
questions.why: The instance profile is the correct profile in this case, as settings in this profile only apply to the affected instance, and the number of work processes for an instance is defined here. In the default profile, you maintain parameters that apply to all instances or for the entire SAP system. The background profile does not exist. Read more about this in the course ADM100, Unit 1, lesson 2.

questions.question: Before using transaction RZ10 for maintaining profile parameters and their values, it is initially required to import the profiles into the SAP system. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: Before using transaction RZ10 for maintaining profile parameters and their values, it is initially required to import the profiles into the SAP system. Read more on this in the lesson "Explaining How Profile Parameters are Set" of the course ADM100.

questions.question: In what sequence should you perform the listed steps when setting up operation modes?

options.text: 1. Create operation modes 2. Assign instance 3. Distribute work processes 4. Maintain time table
1. Create operation modes 2. Maintain time table 3. Distribute work processes 4. Assign instances
1. Create operation modes 2. Distribute work processes 3. Maintain time table 4. Assign instances

questions.why: You must follow the correct sequence when first setting up the operation modes. Read more on this in the lessons 3 and 4 of the course ADM100.

questions.question: Using operation modes, which options are available to you? (2)

options.text: Changing the number of Dialog work processes, provided at least 2 of those remain.
Switch operation modes at 4:15pm in the afternoon.
Increase the number of Spool work processes.
Decrease the number of update work processes from a number higher than 0 to Zero.

questions.why: Operation modes can be used to adapt the number of dialog work processes, provided at least 2 dialog work processes remain configured. Also you can plan operation mode switches in quarter hour intervals. It is not possible to change the number of spool work processes or to decrease the number of update work processes, using operation modes. Read more on this in the lesson "Setting Up Operation Modes" of the course ADM100.

questions.question: How can you execute a set of selected activities using the ABAP Task Manager?

options.text: You need to use a Task List that contains the wanted activities.
You are required to execute each wanted task separately, manually.
You upload a spreadsheet file to the ABAP Task Manager containing all wanted tasks.
You provide the location of a task file that you created earlier during a recording of the wanted activities.

questions.why: ABAP Task Manager executes tasks that you compiled into a Task List – or you can use a predefined Task List. It is not required to execute each task manually, nor is it an option to upload or provide the location of some file containing the wanted activities. Read more on this in the lesson "Working with ABAP Task Manager" of the course ADM100.

questions.question: You can use the Config Tool to maintain Java VM parameters for an SAP NetWeaver AS Java instance. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: You can maintain parameters such as Xms with the Config Tool. Xms is a Java VM parameter.

questions.question: Which of the following technology components for HTTP-based communication can be used together with an SAP S/4HANA system? (3)

options.text: SAP Internet Transaction Server (SAP ITS), standalone
SAP Internet Transaction Server (SAP ITS), integrated

questions.why: With an SAP S/4HANA system, you can use the integrated SAP ITS, the ICM and SAP Web Dispatcher. The standalone SAP ITS is not supported with SAP S/4HANA.

questions.question: Which of the following statements about Internet Communication Manager (ICM) are correct? (2)

options.text: Similar to the number of work processes of a certain type, you can use an instance profile parameter to specify the number of ICM processes that are started for each ABAP dispatcher.
It is recommended that you operate a separate ICM for each client in an AS ABAP based SAP system.
ICM has replaced the Java Dispatcher process as of SAP NetWeaver AS Java 7.10.
ICM can support communication protocols like HTTP, HTTPS and SMTP.

questions.why: As of SAP NetWeaver AS Java 7.10, the ICM has replaced the Java Dispatcher process. In addition, the ICM supports protocols like HTTP, HTPS and SMTP.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the SAP UI Development Toolkit for HTML5 (SAPUI5)?

options.text: To provide a server-side rendering library.
To offer a database management system.
To support application developers in creating HTML5 and JavaScript-based applications.
To serve as a networking protocol for SAP data.

questions.why: SAPUI5 is indeed designed to assist developers in creating applications that are fast and easy to use, utilizing HTML5 and JavaScript.

questions.question: Which tool is used for the configuration of the Web service on the provider side?
questions.why: SAP offers transaction SOAMANAGER for the configuration of the Web service on the provider side and on the consumer side. The ABAP Workbench is used for the implementation of the functions on the provider side and the call of these functions on the consumer side. The Web Services Navigator (available on AS Java) can be used for testing Web services.

questions.question: Which of the following statements accurately describes how to install SAP Web Dispatcher using SWPM?

options.text: The installation of SAP Web Dispatcher via SWPM requires downloading corresponding .SAR files such as SAP Web Dispatcher and SAP Host Agent.
SWPM installs SAP Web Dispatcher using a bootstrap only, without requiring any archives or profile files.
SAP Web Dispatcher can only be installed using Software Provisioning Manager 2.0 to ensure Unicode compatibility.
SAPinst executable does not have a specific option for SAP Web Dispatcher installation.

questions.why: The installation of SAP Web Dispatcher using SWPM involves downloading and using specific .SAR files like SAP Web Dispatcher and SAP Host Agent.

questions.question: SAPconnect allows you to connect external communication components to an ABAP-based SAP system using different technologies. Which of the following scenarios are possible? (2)
questions.why: SAPconnect offers a HTTP plug-in and an STMP plug-in.

questions.question: What does the following parameter and value mean: icm/SMTP/context_quota = 30?

options.text: 30 percent of the available contexts can be used for HTTP.
30 work processes can be used for SMTP.
30 percent of available contexts can be used for SMTP.
30 is the maximum number of users that may have an e-mail address assigned to their user master data.

questions.why: The parameter icm/SMTP/context_quota = 30 defines what percentage of all available contexts can be used for processing SMTP requests (the maximum number of contexts is restricted in the back-end by the value of the profile parameter rdisp/tm_max_no).

questions.question: The database migration option (DMO) is part of which tool?
questions.why: The database migration option (DMO) is part of the Software Update Manager (SUM) tool.

questions.question: From which Web site can you securely download the full SAP HANA documentation as a .zip file?
questions.why: The Web site for SAP HANA documentation is https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_PLATFORM. Read more on this in the HA200 unit, Discovering SAP HANA.

questions.question: What software innovations did SAP deliver with SAP HANA? (2)
questions.why: Column store, delta store, and partitioning of in-memory tables are innovations delivered by SAP with SAP HANA.

questions.question: In which circumstances do you create a column store table? (3)

options.text: When the calculations are based on a small number of columns
When aggregations or fast search are required
When the table has a large number of columns

questions.why: When the calculations are based on a small number of columns, if aggregations or fast search are required, or when the table has a large number of columns, you should create a column store table.

questions.question: Which components of an SAP HANA appliance do you need to consider for sizing?
questions.why: You need to consider the component memory of an SAP HANA appliance for sizing. Read more about this in the Performing SAP HANA Sizing lesson.

questions.question: Which certified hardware components are listed on the SAP HANA hardware directory? (2)
questions.why: Appliances and enterprise storage systems are listed on the SAP HANA hardware directory.

questions.question: What is the minimum space requirement for the Data Volume? (2)
questions.why: 1.2 * RAM (TDI) and 3 * RAM (Appliance) are the minimum space requirements for the Data Volume.

questions.question: For which system landscape types can you use the SAP HANA Hardware and Cloud Measurement tools to determine if your hardware meets the minimum performance criteria required to run SAP HANA in production use? (2)
questions.why: With the SAP HANA Hardware and Cloud Measurement tools, you can only test SAP HANA single host and SAP HANA scale-out system landscapes. For more information, see the lesson Checking SAP HANA Hardware in the course HA200.

questions.question: Which SAP HANA lifecycle management tools can be used to install the SAP HANA database system?
questions.why: The hdblcm tool can be used to install the SAP HANA database system. Read more about this in the Installing SAP HANA 2.0 lesson found in the HA200 training material.

questions.question: During an SAP HANA installation, which operating system user account is assigned to the trusted local secure store (LSS)?
questions.why: The user <sid>crypt is assigned to the trusted local secure store (LSS). Read more about this in the Describing Advanced Installation Options lesson found in the HA200 training material.

questions.question: SAP HANA tailored data center integration (TDI) is an open and flexible approach for the integration of SAP HANA in the data center. TDI can reduce hardware and operation costs by reusing existing hardware components and processes. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: SAP HANA tailored data center integration (TDI) is an open and flexible approach for the integration of SAP HANA in the data center. Tailored data center integration can reduce hardware and operations cost by reusing existing hardware components and processes. Read more about this topic in the lesson Illustrating Deployment Options.

questions.question: Which of the following administration tools provide the ability for central landscape management? (2)
questions.why: SAP Landscape Management and DBA Cockpit provide a solution for central landscape management.

questions.question: Which operating systems are supported when installing SAP HANA cockpit on IBM Power hardware? (2)
questions.why: SUSE Linux Enterprise Server (SLES) is supported when installing SAP HANA cockpit on IBM Power hardware.

questions.question: SAP HANA cockpit can only be installed on dedicated hardware. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: SAP HANA cockpit can be installed on dedicated hardware, but also in a separate tenant database of an existing SAP HANA database system. Read more about this in the Introducing SAP HANA Cockpit 2.0 lesson.

questions.question: What is the correct order when registering databases and creating groups and SAP HANA cockpit users with the cockpit manager?

options.text: There is no fixed order to follow.

questions.why: There is no fixed order to follow. Read more about this in the Configuring SAP HANA Cockpit 2.0 lesson.

questions.question: Which tools can you use to update SAP HANA cockpit? (2)
questions.why: You can only use hdblcm and resident hdblcm to update SAP HANA cockpit. SWPM and SUM are the tools to be used with SAP ABAP systems. Read more about this in the Updating SAP HANA Cockpit 2.0 lesson.

questions.question: Which of the following SAP HANA license key types locks down the system when the current memory consumption of SAP HANA exceeds the licensed amount of memory?
questions.why: The Enforced license key locks down the system when the current memory consumption of SAP HANA exceeds the licensed amount of memory. Read more about this in the Identify the post-installation steps after an SAP HANA installation lesson in course HA200.

questions.question: The resident HDBLCM located on the SAP HANA installation media performs administrative tasks like installing and updating an SAP HANA database and its core components. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: The resident HDBLCM is not located on the SAP HANA installation media. The resident HDBLCM is located in the path /hana/shared/<SID>/hdblcm. Read more about this in the Updating SAP HANA lesson.

questions.question: Which inter-service communication properties binds the processes to entered address only, and to all local host interfaces?
questions.why: The inter-service communication property Internal binds the processes to entered address only, and to all local host interfaces. Read more about this in the Using the Resident SAP HANA Database Lifecycle Manager Tool lesson.

questions.question: What is the system database used for in a multi-container SAP HANA system? (2)

options.text: Resource management for all tenant databases
User management for all tenant databases
Store information about the location of tables in all tenant databases

questions.why: The system database stores overall system landscape information, including information on the tenant databases that exist in the system. However, it doesn't own database-related topology information, that is, information about the location of tables and table partitions in databases. There is also a clear separation of application data and user management.

questions.question: Which is the default external SQL port number of the tenant database that is automatically created when you install a single-tenant system?
questions.why: The port number of the tenant database that is automatically created when you install a single-tenant system are: 3<instance>03 (internal communication), 3<instance>15 (SQL).

questions.question: What is contained in SAP HANA Cockpit Support Packages? (2)
questions.why: SAP HANA Cockpit Support Packages contain new features and bug fixes. Read more about this in the Explaining the Revision Strategy of SAP HANA lesson.

questions.question: In the context of the SAP HANA maintenance strategy, new features and functions on the SAP HANA platform are shipped in what kind of bundle?
questions.why: In the context of the SAP HANA maintenance strategy, support package stack (SPS) is related to bundling new features and functions on the SAP HANA platform. Read more about this in the Explaining the Revision Strategy of SAP HANA lesson.

questions.question: When connected to the SAP HANA database, which HDBSQL command displays general information about the database?
questions.why: When connected to the SAP HANA database, the HDBSQL command \s displays general information about the database. Read more about this in the Using the SAP HANA HDBSQL Command-Line Tool lesson.

questions.question: Which user account is used when a tenant database connection is automatically added to the database explorer?

options.text: Your personal SAP HANA cockpit user
Your personal SAP HANA database user

questions.why: When automatically adding a database connection to the database explorer, SAP HANA cockpit uses the SAP HANA cockpit personal user credentials already stored for this database connection.

questions.question: What is the best location to use when importing data when the file size is larger than 1GB?
questions.why: Import database objects larger than 1 GB from the SAP HANA host to avoid sending large amounts of data across the network.

questions.question: In the SAP HANA database explorer, as the user SYSTEM, you can access the table data in every database schema. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: The user SYSTEM, by default, doesn't have full access to every the tables in all the schemas. To get access, the table owner needs to grant the select privilege from a table to the SYSTEM user.

questions.question: In SAP HANA, the database administrator can't manually unload table data. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: Using the SAP HANA database explorer, the database administrator can load and unload the table data manually.

questions.question: Which schema stores the historical performance data of SAP HANA?
questions.why: The embedded statistics server assists you with monitoring the SAP HANA system, collects historical performance data, and warns you of system alerts (such as resource exhaustion). The historical data is stored in the _SYS_STATISTICS schema. For more information, see the lesson Using SAP HANA Mini Checks.

questions.question: When a registered SAP HANA resource is offline, the version number 0.00.000.00.0 (UNKNOWN) is displayed on the Database Directory page of SAP HANA cockpit to indicate an improper shutdown. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: When the SAP HANA resource is offline or shut down, the correct version number is shown. Read more about this in the Daily Database Administration Tasks lesson.

questions.question: The index server runs in the system database and contains the actual data stores and the engines for processing the data. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: The index server, which runs in every tenant database (but not the system database), contains the actual data stores and the engines for processing the data.

questions.question: Which components of the SAP HANA Memory Pool are part of the SAP HANA Used Memory? (3)
questions.why: SAP HANA employs the term used memory to indicate the portion of the virtual memory that is in current use for code, stacks, tables and intermediate results.

questions.question: How does the SAP HANA database organize the storage of column store data on the disk volume?

options.text: Pages with sizes from 4 KB to 16 MB, which are arranged in superblocks of 64 MB
Pages with a fixed size of 16 KB, which are arranged in superblocks of 64 MB
Pages with sizes from 4 KB to 16 MB
Pages with a fixed size of 64 MB

questions.why: The SAP HANA database organizes the column store data in pages with sizes from 4 KB to 16 MB, which are arranged in superblocks of 64 MB.

questions.question: When configuring SAP HANA alerts, you can only enter one email recipient per alert. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: You can configure more than one email recipient per alert.

questions.question: Which protocol is used by the statistics service to collects statistical and performance information?
questions.why: The statistics service uses SQL to read the data from the SAP HANA monitoring views.

questions.question: In which SAP HANA server processes does the statistics scheduler thread run?
questions.why: The scheduler thread is part of the statistics server that runs in the nameserver service. Calls are sent to the indexserver to call SQLScript procedures.

questions.question: Which resource can you dynamically influence using workload classes? (2)
questions.why: Workload classes allow you to influence resource consumption for Statement memory limit and Statement thread limit.

questions.question: Which users are able to start and stop a distributed SAP HANA database system? (2)
questions.why: The <sid>adm user and the ROOT user are able to start and stop a distributed SAP HANA database system. Read more on this in the lesson Starting and Stopping SAP HANA.

questions.question: Assume the following scenario: An SAP HANA system is configured for the parameter savepoint_interval_s with the value 300s on the DEFAULT layer, but the SYSTEM layer value is 450s, and as a third parameter value, the included tenant is configured on the DATABASE layer with the value 600s. Which value will be taken into account during runtime for the tenant database?

options.text: The DATABASE layer value 600s, because it overrides SYSTEM and DEFAULT layer values.
The SYSTEM layer value 450s, because a tenant-specific savepoint parameters are not allowed.
The DEFAULT layer value 300s, because it is recommended by SAP and ignores all other values.

questions.why: Values set at SYSTEM layer override values of layer DEFAULT. The same applies to DATABASE layer values, which are higher prioritized than SYSTEM layer values. For details, see the lesson Changing Database Configuration Parameters in HA200.

questions.question: Which of the following system views provides violation information about unsupported values for configuration parameters in your SAP HANA database system?
questions.why: The M_CONFIGURATION_PARAMETER_VALUES system view specifies the restrictions violated by the set value (CUSTOM, VALUE_RESTRICTION, or LAYER_RESTRICTION).

questions.question: What are the advantages of using the delta merge in the memory management of the column store? (3)

options.text: Highly compressed data in the main storage to realize read optimization
Write operations only affect the delta storage but not the main storage
Partial loading is possible in the delta storage
High write performance by implementing a delta storage mechanism, which uses only basic compression

questions.why: Highly compressed data is provided in the main storage and therefore optimized for read operations. Write actions are purely linked to the delta storage, which only uses basic compression in order to provide a high write performance. The delta storage can only be fully loaded or unloaded. Partial loading is not possible. For more information, read the lesson Explaining the Concept of Delta Merge in HA200.

questions.question: Which of the following traces has the default configuration status "Active"?
questions.why: The Database trace has the default configuration status "Active". Read more about this in the Working with SAP HANA Traces lesson.

questions.question: You can only generate the full system information dump file using the SAP HANA cockpit. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: The full system information dump file can also be generated using the Python script fullSystemInfoDump.py on the command line. Read more about this in the Working with SAP HANA Traces lesson in the course HA200.

questions.question: What parts of the SAP HANA database system can be backed up and restored separately? (2)
questions.why: Tenants and configuration files can be separately backed up and restored. Database objects like schemas and virtual tables cannot be separately backed up and restored.

questions.question: Which backup types are delta backups in SAP HANA? (2)
questions.why: Differential and incremental are the two delta backup types supported by SAP HANA.

questions.question: Which backup types are available when you schedule a data backup? (2)
questions.why: The SAP HANA backup scheduler supports Complete, Differential, and Incremental backups.

questions.question: Your SAP HANA database is running in log mode Normal and automatic log backups are enabled. With this configuration, in which situations are the log segments backed up automatically? (2)

options.text: The log segment is closed after 3 seconds.

questions.why: In log mode Normal with automatic log backups enabled, the log segments are backed up automatically when the log segment is full, when the database is started, or when the log segment is closed after exceeding the configured time threshold.

questions.question: Which of the following recovery types is not supported for delta backups?

options.text: Recover the database to its most recent state.
Recover the database to a specific point in time.
Recover the database to a specific data backup.

questions.why: Recovery to a specific data backup can only performed using a complete backup. Delta (differential and Incremental) backups are not complete backups.

questions.question: To diagnose backup errors, you can use the backup.log and backint.log files. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: Read more on this in the Describing Additional Backup Topics lesson in course HA200.

questions.question: From which backup types can SAP HANA resume a recovery? (2)
questions.why: SAP HANA can resume a database recovery from incremental, differential data backups, or from log backups.

questions.question: The creation of storage snapshots has a big impact on the system, and recovery from storage snapshots takes longer. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: Read more about this in the Explaining Backup and Recovery Using Data Snapshots lesson of the course HA200.

questions.question: In your backup cycle, you can use daily fallback snapshots. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: A fallback snapshot does not replace a database backup.

questions.question: Which of the following elements are required for implementing a database copy? (2)

options.text: The target database must have the same or higher version than the source database.
The host number of the source and the target system are identical.
Source and target databases can have different number and types of services.
A data backup (file-based backups or backups using a third-party backup tool) or storage snapshot of the source system is available.

questions.why: To implement a database copy, the target database must have the same or higher version than the source database and a data backup (file-based backups or backups using a third-party backup tool) or storage snapshot of the source system must be available.

questions.question: Under which user runs the local secure store (LSS) on the SAP HANA server?
questions.why: The LSS is a separate lightweight utility that runs as a separate service on the SAP HANA server under a different operating system user (<sid>crypt), in order to strictly separate duties on operating system level.

questions.question: You cannot force all clients who communicate with the SAP HANA database through the SQL interface to use a secured connection. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: Read more about this in the Explaining Encryption lesson in the course HA200.

questions.question: Which of the following actions can be audited by SAP HANA? (2)

options.text: Upgrade of an SAP HANA database instance
Create or drop user, and create or drop role

questions.why: Changes to system configuration and creation or dropping of a user or role can be audited by SAP HANA.

questions.question: The password policy parameters for the system database of a multiple-container system are maintained in the indexserver.ini file. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: Read more on this in the lesson Understanding SAP HANA Authentication and Authorization in the course HA200.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is true for the SAP HANA preinstalled role (SAP_INTERNAL_HANA_SUPPORT) for support cases?

options.text: It can be granted to the SYSTEM user.
It can be granted to another role.
It can only be granted further system privileges.
It can only be granted further object privileges.

questions.why: Read more about this in the "Understanding SAP HANA Roles" lesson in the course HA200.

questions.question: Which of the following privileges allow read access to data in SAP HANA information models depending on certain values or combination of values?
questions.why: Analytic privileges allow read access to data in SAP HANA information models depending on certain values or combination of values.

questions.question: Which of the following tools can be used for user administration? (3)
questions.why: You can administer users with SAP HANA cockpit, hdbsql, and SAP Identity Management.

questions.question: In SAP HANA databases, user groups are mandatory and have to be used by customers. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: The use of user groups in SAP HANA databases is optional and enhances the functionality of user and role management. Read more on this in the lesson Managing Groups in the course HA200.

questions.question: Which system view allows you to review the authentication method assigned to your user account?
questions.why: The system view M_CONNECTIONS contains additional information about the authentication method.

questions.question: By default, from where reads an SAP ABAP application server the database connection information?

options.text: The hdbuserstore on the SAP HANA server.
The hdbuserstore on the SAP ABAP application server.
The Local Secure Store on the SAP ABAP application server.
The Secure Storage in File System on the SAP HANA server.

questions.why: By default, the database connection information is retrieved from the hdbuserstore on the SAP ABAP application server.

questions.question: Which of the following database resources can be monitored in the DBA Cockpit Current Status Overview monitor? (3)

options.text: The time at which the database was started
Disk consumption from the SAP HANA database
Memory and CPU consumption from the SAP HANA database

questions.why: The database start time, database disk usage, and memory and CPU consumption can be monitored in the DBA Cockpit Current Status Overview monitor.

questions.question: SAP Landscape Management is a powerful automated solution designed to simplify, centralize, and orchestrate the management and operations of the entire application landscape powered by SAP HANA. With the enterprise edition of SAP Landscape Management, you can perform various operations on SAP HANA instances, such as start, stop, monitor, or system replication operations. Determine whether this statement is true or false.
questions.why: Read more on this in the Managing SAP Landscapes lesson.
